name: 生态学与生态系统科学预设
description: 涵盖个体、种群、群落、生态系统至生物圈多尺度生态学，聚焦物种相互作用、营养级能量流动、生物地球化学循环、环境理化驱动与生态干扰。
en_description: Multi-scale ecological ontology spanning organism, population, community, ecosystem, and biosphere, focusing on trophic energy flows, biogeochemical cycling, abiotic drivers, and disturbances.

Organism_Taxon.name: 物种 / 种群 / 生物分类单元
Organism_Taxon.label: 物种 / 种群 / 生物分类单元
Organism_Taxon.description: 生态系统中的植物、动物、微生物、浮游生物及各营养级功能群或特定生物分类单元
Organism_Taxon.en_description: Organisms, populations, functional guilds, and biological taxa across trophic levels.
patterns: .*(?:species|population|taxon|taxa|fauna|flora|microbiota|plankton|benthos|herbivore|carnivore|omnivore|detritivore|producer|consumer|decomposer)$
.*(?:物种|种群|分类群|生物区系|植物相|动物相|浮游生物|浮游动物|浮游植物|底栖生物|大型底栖动物|植食动物|肉食动物|杂食动物|碎屑食者|生产者|消费者|分解者|微生态|微生物群|菌群|节肢动物|昆虫|鸟类|鱼类|哺乳动物|啮齿动物)$
^(?:predator|prey|host|parasite|symbiont|competitor|invader|alien species|keystone species|foundation species|flagship species|endemic species|native species)$
^(?:捕食者|猎物|宿主|寄生者|共生体|竞争者|入侵种|关键种|建群种|旗舰种|特有种|本土种)$

Abiotic_Factor.name: 非生物环境因子 / 理化参数
Abiotic_Factor.label: 非生物环境因子 / 理化参数
Abiotic_Factor.description: 温度、降水、光照、湿度、pH、盐度、溶解氧、气候及土壤物理质地等无机环境驱动要素
Abiotic_Factor.en_description: Physical and chemical abiotic environmental drivers including climate, moisture, irradiance, and soil properties.
patterns: .*(?:temperature|precipitation|humidity|salinity|irradiance|turbidity|conductivity|depth|elevation|altitude)$
.*(?:温度|气温|水温|降水|降雨量|湿度|盐度|光照强度|光周期|浑浊度|电导率|水深|海拔|酸碱度|ph值)$
^(?:ph|do|dissolved oxygen|bod|cod|par|photosynthetically active radiation|uv-b|soil moisture|soil texture|nitrogen deposition|drought|flood|hypoxia|anoxia)$
^(?:溶解氧|生物需氧量|化学需氧量|光合有效辐射|土壤含水量|土壤孔隙度|土壤质地|氮沉降|干旱|洪涝|低氧|缺氧)$

Nutrient_Biogeochemical.name: 营养盐 / 碳氮磷循环分子 / 污染物
Nutrient_Biogeochemical.label: 营养盐 / 碳氮磷循环分子 / 污染物
Nutrient_Biogeochemical.description: 碳、氮、磷、硫生物地球化学循环分子、无机养分、温室气体、活性离子与生态环境污染物
Nutrient_Biogeochemical.en_description: Biogeochemical cycling molecules (C, N, P, S), inorganic nutrients, greenhouse gases, and chemical pollutants.
patterns: .*(?:nutrient|fertilizer|greenhouse gas|pollutant|heavy metal|microplastic)$
.*(?:营养盐|养分|肥料|温室气体|污染物|重金属|微塑料|有机碎屑)$
^(?:co2|ch4|n2o|nh4\+|no3-|no2-|po43-|h2s|so42-|doc|don|dop|pom|som|soc|soil organic carbon|total nitrogen|total phosphorus)$

Habitat_Ecosystem.name: 生境 / 生态系统 / 景观斑块
Habitat_Ecosystem.label: 生境 / 生态系统 / 景观斑块
Habitat_Ecosystem.description: 森林、湿地、草原、海洋、淡水、农田等生态系统类型及微生境、廊道与景观场域
Habitat_Ecosystem.en_description: Biomes, ecosystems, habitats, landscapes, riparian corridors, and ecological patches.
patterns: .*(?:ecosystem|biome|habitat|landscape|wetland|estuary|watershed|catchment|riparian|corridor|ecotone)$
.*(?:生态系统|生物群系|生境|栖息地|景观|湿地|河口|流域|集水区|河岸带|生态廊道|群落交错区|生态过渡带|森林|草原|荒漠|苔原|农田|珊瑚礁)$
^(?:forest|grassland|desert|tundra|ocean|marine|freshwater|lake|river|stream|peatland|mangrove|coral reef|intertidal zone)$

Ecological_Process.name: 生态过程 / 能量流动 / 演替动态
Ecological_Process.label: 生态过程 / 能量流动 / 演替动态
Ecological_Process.description: 初级/次级生产力、生物量积累、光合固碳、呼吸释放、群落演替、分解矿化及生物富集过程
Ecological_Process.en_description: Primary/secondary production, biomass accumulation, carbon flux, succession, decomposition, and biomagnification.
patterns: .*(?:succession|photosynthesis|respiration|flux|sequestration|mineralization|decomposition|eutrophication|bioaccumulation|biomagnification)$
.*(?:演替|光合作用|呼吸作用|能量流动|碳汇|碳固定|矿化作用|分解作用|富营养化|生物富集|生物放大|生态恢复|生态退化)$
^(?:primary production|secondary production|nep|gpp|npp|net ecosystem exchange|biomass accumulation|nutrient cycling|litter decomposition)$
^(?:初级生产力|次级生产力|净初级生产量|总初级生产量|生态系统净交换量|生物量积累|养分循环|凋落物分解)$

Disturbance_Stress.name: 生态干扰 / 环境胁迫 / 人类活动
Disturbance_Stress.label: 生态干扰 / 环境胁迫 / 人类活动
Disturbance_Stress.description: 火灾、病虫害、外来物种入侵、土地利用变化、生境破碎化、过度捕捞及全球气候变暖等干扰
Disturbance_Stress.en_description: Wildfires, pest outbreaks, biological invasions, land-use change, fragmentation, and climate warming disturbances.
patterns: .*(?:disturbance|stress|degradation|deforestation|wildfire|overfishing|acidification|fragmentation)$
.*(?:生态干扰|环境胁迫|退化|毁林|森林火灾|过度捕捞|水体富营养化|海洋酸化|生境破碎化|土地利用变化|过度放牧|盗猎)$
^(?:climate change|global warming|heat wave|habitat loss|urbanization|biological invasion|pest outbreak|oil spill)$
^(?:气候变化|全球变暖|热浪|生境丧失|城市化|生物入侵|病虫害暴发|漏油事故)$

Uncertain.name: 待定 / 无法判断
Uncertain.label: 待定 / 无法判断
Uncertain.description: 证据不充分或未命中的生态学概念与实体
Uncertain.en_description: Ecological entities with ambiguous context or pending escalation analysis.

Trophic_Feeding.name: 营养摄食 / 捕食 / 寄生
Trophic_Feeding.label: 营养摄食 / 捕食 / 寄生
Trophic_Feeding.description: 捕食、植食、寄生及腐生等食物网能量摄取与下行营养级控制关系
Trophic_Feeding.en_description: Trophic interactions including predation, herbivory, parasitism, and food web energy consumption.

Mutualism_Symbiosis.name: 互利共生 / 互惠促进
Mutualism_Symbiosis.label: 互利共生 / 互惠促进
Mutualism_Symbiosis.description: 传粉、种子传播、菌根共生、根瘤固氮及珊瑚清洁共生等双向互惠促进关系
Mutualism_Symbiosis.en_description: Mutualistic and symbiotic facilitation including pollination, mycorrhizae, and nitrogen fixation.

Competition_Exclusion.name: 资源竞争 / 竞争排斥 / 他感抑制
Competition_Exclusion.label: 资源竞争 / 竞争排斥 / 他感抑制
Competition_Exclusion.description: 对光照、水肥、食物或领地等有限资源的种内/种间对抗竞争及植物化感相克
Competition_Exclusion.en_description: Intra/interspecific resource competition, ecological competitive exclusion, and allelopathic suppression.

Environmental_Drive.name: 环境驱动 / 胁迫耐受
Environmental_Drive.label: 环境驱动 / 胁迫耐受
Environmental_Drive.description: 非生物物理化学因子对生物个体生长、死亡、种群丰度及地理分布的调控
Environmental_Drive.en_description: Abiotic physicochemical factors driving growth, mortality, abundance, or geographical distribution.

Biogeochemical_Flux.name: 物质循环 / 养分通量 / 转化释放
Biogeochemical_Flux.label: 物质循环 / 养分通量 / 转化释放
Biogeochemical_Flux.description: 养分吸收固定、有机质矿化分解、温室气体排放及生物地球化学元素沉积转化
Biogeochemical_Flux.en_description: Nutrient uptake, decomposition mineralization, greenhouse gas emission, and elemental transformation.

Ecological_Facilitation.name: 生态工程营造 / 级联调控
Ecological_Facilitation.label: 生态工程营造 / 级联调控
Ecological_Facilitation.description: 关键种或生态工程师改造物理生境（如海狸筑坝），或营养级联自上而下/自下而上的间接调控
Ecological_Facilitation.en_description: Physical habitat modification by ecosystem engineers and indirect top-down or bottom-up trophic cascades.

Spatial_Containment.name: 生境空间包含 / 群落归属
Spatial_Containment.label: 生境空间包含 / 群落归属
Spatial_Containment.description: 物种归属于特定生物群落、微生境隶属于特定生态系统或景观斑块
Spatial_Containment.en_description: Hierarchical spatial containment, community co-occurrence, and landscape patch membership.
